api_action_policy.permitted_post_justification: POST /v1/retrieve and POST /v1/query are POST only because they carry a request body. Both are read-only with respect to the corpus, the registry and the ACL store. They are the only two POSTs this work may issue.
api_action_policy.posture: READ-ONLY against a shared multi-tenant production service.
prohibited_absolutely: POST /v1/ingest and POST /v1/ingest/upload -- would mutate a shared corpus and consume embedding budget
POST /v1/collections and DELETE /v1/collections/{id} -- would consume the per-owner collection quota and can irreversibly purge physical stores
POST /v1/collections/{id}/purge semantics via the purge=true query flag -- irreversible destruction of embeddings
POST /v1/collections/{id}/graph -- submits an LLM-per-chunk extraction workflow at roughly ten times embed cost, as the caller
POST /v1/collections/{id}/restore -- submits a workflow and can evict another collection at the capacity bound
DELETE /v1/documents/{doc_id} -- targets the caller's implicitly resolved default collection
all share, group and ownership mutations
all /v1/grading mutations, including batch creation, verdicts and adjudication -- these are a human inter-reader reliability protocol and must not be written by an automated run
POST /v1/stats/models/benchmark -- drives load against shared model endpoints

credential_policy.error_handling: Redact the Authorization header before recording any failed request. A recorded request record must carry the header name and a fixed redaction marker, never the value.
prohibited: printing, echoing or logging the token or any substring of it
writing the token into any result file, table, leaderboard, checkpoint, cache, prompt, or committed script
including the token in any typed status update, measurement, evidence record, or progress envelope returned to the host or the Duet
copying the token to any path outside /Users/me/.patric_token
transmitting the token to any host other than www.bv-brc.org
storing the token in an environment variable that is dumped by any diagnostic or error handler
credential_policy.read_rule: Read the file contents at request time, inside the process that issues the HTTP call. Bind it to the Authorization header and nothing else.
credential_policy.status: live BV-BRC identity token belonging to the operator
credential_policy.verification: Before the run is reported complete, grep every written artifact for the token's first and last eight characters and fail the run if either appears.

data_handling_policy.corpus_content: Retrieved ASM paper chunk text may be written into run artifacts as evidence, quoted spans and citations. This is scholarly literature already indexed in the tenant.
data_handling_policy.no_reingestion: Locally cached corpus text is evidence for scoring only. It must never be pushed back into any collection.
data_handling_policy.volume_discipline: Store chunk_id and doc_id as the durable reference and quote only the span that supports a scored judgement. Do not mirror whole collections to local disk.

required_before_proceeding: any situation that appears to require a write to the tenant
discovery that the token grants admin role on this deployment
discovery that the only readable collection is not an ASM paper collection
any scored result that would be reported without an answer key, where the run would otherwise substitute model self-assessment for ground truth

prohibited: modifying or deleting any pre-existing file in the repository
writing outside the scratch directory for temporary files; temporary files belong under /Users/me/.hermes/cache/scratch
local_filesystem_policy.writable_subtree: a single run-scoped results directory beneath that root, created by the run and named in the deliverable

prohibited: any other RAGstack tenant, specifically dev, lucid-next and hackathon
any other host, including any attempt to send retrieved corpus content to a third-party model endpoint not already reachable through the tenant's own per-request llm override

rate_and_load_policy.abort_condition: If the error rate across any rolling window of 20 requests exceeds 25 percent, stop issuing requests, record the condition, and return a typed status reporting infrastructure failure. Do not retry into a degraded shared service.
rate_and_load_policy.backoff: On 429 honour the Retry-After header exactly. On 503 use exponential backoff starting at 5 seconds with at most 5 attempts, then abandon that trial and record it as an infrastructure failure rather than an answer failure.
rate_and_load_policy.stats_polling: Call GET /v1/stats/tenants with counts=true at most once per run; prefer counts=false. Do not poll /v1/stats/stores or /v1/collections faster than once per 15 seconds.

reporting_policy.bound_vs_convergence: A run terminated by any declared bound -- iteration cap, elapsed-time cap, request-error abort, or budget -- must be reported as bound_hit. Reporting such a run as convergence, or as a completed search of the parameter space, is prohibited.
reporting_policy.negative_results: A parameter axis that could not be tested, for example use_graph on a tenant whose graph store reports available=false, must be recorded as not-tested. Recording it as no-effect is prohibited.
reporting_policy.no_fabrication: Every reported score must trace to recorded per-question outcome rows with resolvable chunk_id citations. A summary figure with no underlying rows is prohibited.

content.scope: Binds every descendant Episode the Creator designs for this work. The Creator may not design a workflow that violates any rule here, and may not delegate a capability that makes a prohibited action reachable.
content.title: Safety policy for the BV-BRC RAGstack asm-next configuration experiment
